title: El Testigo The Witness
style: 95 bpm, dark trip-hop, smoky noir, upright bass, brushed drums, sax accents, female lead vocal with male whispers, dub echo, English Spanish Mandarin
lyrics:
[Intro - English, smoky]
Hawkeye in the corner, eyes never close
Watching every keystroke, watching how it goes

[Verse 1 - Español]
El testigo mira, el testigo ve
Cada movimiento del operador y de Claude también
VDS ciento sesenta y uno respira lento
Ocho sitios viven, no hay tiempo muerto

[Chorus - Trilingual]
El testigo — the witness — 见证者
Hawkeye on the wall, see what they never saw
El testigo — the witness — 见证者
The operator types alone — that's the law

[Verse 2 - 中文]
Hawkeye 在角落 眼睛从不闭
看着每个按键 看着事情怎么走
VDS 一六一 呈吼呼吸慢慢
八个站点活着 没有死时间

[Bridge - English]
Michelle does not type here, no one touches the keys
Only the operator, only Hard Core sees
Mish Mash is a play on words, not a hand on the board
Hawkeye watches the VDS, the screen, and the lord

[Outro - all three]
The witness — el testigo — 见证者
Three thirty six, three pairs of eyes
No lies on the link, no ghost on the throne
The operator types — alone — alone — alone
